champion.tips: LEBLANC TIPS AND TRICKS Play around enemy cooldowns. If the enemy Support or ADC uses one ability, look to combo them with your Q > W . Leblanc is a strong roamer, especially after she has got her first item. Try to roam from base: utilising your W to move around the map fast and help your allies. Leblanc should look to assassinate isolated targets that are moving through the river alone in the mid to late game.
champion.builds: THE BEST LEBLANC BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular LeBlanc Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Gathering Storm and Transcendence in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Luden's Companion. For your last 3 items, you should build Stormsurge, Shadowflame and finish with Rabadon's Deathcap. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 49.3% winrate over 3 807 matches played. Optional Your second option for LeBlanc Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are First Strike as your keystone, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Luden's Companion as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Stormsurge, Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is W - Q - E. In the current patch, this build has a 47.1% win rate over 437 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Gathering Storm with Transcendence in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Luden's Companion as a third item. You want to finish the build with Stormsurge, Zhonya's Hourglass and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 47.7% win rate across 426 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta LeBlanc Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Gathering Storm with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Luden's Companion as third item. The last 3 options are Stormsurge, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 51.2% win rate over 250 matches played. Situational LeBlanc Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your LeBlanc build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out LeBlanc runes page.
